target: Chronicle ingress hygiene on activity.events.v1: event_id-based deduplication and pre-storage PII redaction in the dope-memory intake path.
invariants: Dedup is idempotent and replay-safe: the same event_id is never stored twice.
Redaction happens before persistence; raw PII never reaches disk.
Envelope/payload contract stays coordinated with SVCFEAT-003 (task.*/workflow.phase_changed) — no divergent schema.

commit.message: feat(dope-memory): event_id dedup + pre-storage PII redaction on chronicle ingress

pr.title: feat(dope-memory): chronicle ingress dedup + PII redaction
pr.body:
Implements addendum §2.6/2.7: event_id dedup (unique index / TTL set) and configurable PII masking (emails, tokens, absolute paths) applied before storage in the dope-memory intake for activity.events.v1.

Anchor: claudedocs/mcp-fleet-reconciliation-2026-07-18.md (P7/HRD).

steps.task: Add event_id dedup to the intake path (unique constraint or TTL-backed seen-set) with replay-safety tests. Prior art: services/mcp-capture proves SHA-256 content-addressed dedup (identical events from different adapters collapse to one chronicle.sqlite row) with fail-closed input validation — mirror that pattern for stream ingress where event_id is absent or untrusted.
validation: Test proves replaying an identical event twice yields exactly one stored entry and no error.

steps.task: Add a pre-storage redaction pass (configurable patterns: emails, bearer tokens, absolute home paths) and document the config.
validation: Test: an event seeded with an email and token is stored with both masked; redaction config documented in docs/03-reference/systems/dope-memory.
